Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

With coagulation factors and platelet function tests unavailable, I must rely on the clinical presentation of spontaneous hemarthrosis in a young male with a family history. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A
